name: Self Help
overview: Scripture teaches that true self-help is found not in relying solely on our own strength, but in recognizing that we are wonderfully made by God and empowered through Christ. Isaiah 41:10 assures us that God Himself strengthens and upholds us, while Philippians 4:13 emphasizes that we can do all things through Christ who strengthens us. Transformation and renewal of the mind, as described in Romans 12:2, are essential for discerning God's perfect will, underscoring that genuine growth comes from divine empowerment rather than worldly conformity.
